availableCommands.name: skill:voice-builder
availableCommands.description: Builds a grounded voice & tone profile skill for a person by mining their real communications — team-chat DMs and channels, email, call & meeting transcripts, documents, and any pasted samples. Identifies both how the person WRITES/SPEAKS (voice, register-by-context, humor, feedback style, recurring sayings) and WHO they are (role, seniority, domain, remit, relationships). Outputs a per-person voice skill named after the person (like john-smith-voice), where every trait is backed by a real quoted example. Triggers — "build a voice profile", "voice builder", "create a voice skill for someone", "capture my/someone's voice from chat/email/transcripts", "analyze how someone communicates", "make a voice & tone skill".

availableCommands.name: skill:writing-coach
availableCommands.description: Coach and editor for writing anything in your OWN words — posts, essays, emails, PRs, talks, docs, of any length. Use when the user wants to WRITE something themselves with guidance, NOT have it written for them. Walks from topic and rough points, through a discovery interview, then paragraph by paragraph — naming the job of each line, reflecting the writer's intent back, editing using only the writer's own words, and escalating from Socratic questions to a flagged "spark" only when truly stuck. Keeps a cross-session coach's notebook of the writer's patterns so it makes them a better writer over time. Triggers — "help me write", "coach me through", "be my editor", "writing coach", "I want to write X myself", "go paragraph by paragraph".

availableCommands.name: skill:xlsx
availableCommands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

availableCommands.name: skill:yealink-admin
availableCommands.description: Yealink IP phone administration guide for SIP-T2, T3, T4, T5, and CP92X series phones (firmware V86.5). Load this skill whenever the user asks about Yealink phone configuration, provisioning, SIP registration, firmware upgrades, audio settings, phone customization, call features, troubleshooting, or any Yealink-specific setting or parameter. Also trigger for questions about specific models: T54W, T57W, T48U, T46U, T43U, T42U, T46S, T42S, T41S, T48S, T33P, T33G, T31P, T31G, T29G, T27G, CP920, CP925, EXP40, EXP43, EXP50. If someone asks about auto-provisioning CFG files, boot files, dial plans, codecs, DTMF, BLF, DSS keys, line keys, or any phone hardware/software topic -- use this skill.
